529.issue_title: Establish client delivery and structured payload guarantees

cycles.cycle_name: Profile contracts and truthful serialization facts

deliverables.description: Implement frozen response-profile configuration, version 2.0.0 defaults, positive resolved budgets and explicit per-process selector through existing Settings/bootstrap seams; update directly affected configuration builders without old-key aliases.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Truthful canonical serialization and publication diagnosis
deliverables.description: Remove concealed replacement-JSON success; preserve original native errors/causes through existing capture_exception and CachePublication diagnostic union; no entry or eviction on failed serialization. Preserve normal canonical representation and cache read/window API.

Define the approved common envelope, inline/resource alternatives and both delivery-error codes at the existing presentation-output boundary; keep internal operation DTOs and ToolExecution intact. Prove required value/config/error invariants through focused existing tests.

cycles.exit_criteria: Focused configuration/settings, publication and cache-fidelity behavior tests pass, including original exception/cause and independent valid operation facts; changed Python files pass applicable directed format/lint/type checks; native YAML checks pass changed config. No runtime legacy/compatibility mode. Existing loaded server remains available until the complete C_2 activation.

cycles.cycle_name: Protected presentation, profile delivery and live cutover

deliverables.deliverable_name: Protected rendering and bounded diagnostic details
deliverables.description: Render required template/enum/instruction/note content independently from full JSON serialization, separate optional collections, and update the existing limiter to preserve mandatory core with explicit overruns and UTF-8-safe detail bounds.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Selected MCP envelope and configuration-independent recovery
deliverables.description: Resolve/inject the process-local profile, route full operation data and attachments, emit the matching common output schema and truthful independent cache/inline emergency variants, retain actual isError; use fixed full dual-channel startup recovery. Remove bare structured assignment, unconditional resource copies, unlimited fallback and absent-presenter bypass.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Current behavioral consumer evidence and activation
deliverables.description: Adapt existing direct presenter/transport/bootstrap tests and shared constructors to the clean contract; prove representative channel combinations, native SDK schema acceptance, full operation/resource/attachment routes, two instances sharing config, startup recovery and both serializer failure directions. Restart/reload the completed server and perform focused healthy live calls; keep temporary probes out of permanent suite.

cycles.exit_criteria: Focused presenter/limiter/interface/schema/server tests and directly affected SDK integration consumers pass; branch-selected focused groups remain bounded to touched seams. Directed production/test checks pass. Completed server restarts healthy and preserves work-context instructions. All old-route remnants removed; no compatibility or client-specific code. Request independent QA before Validation.

deliverables.description: Record one full native-configured suite, branch gates, production-scoped Mypy and configured Python checks; map every deliverable/invariant, actual failure outcomes, cleanup, process isolation and live evidence without relying on transient run IDs.

deliverables.deliverable_name: Current profile, setup and cache-reading documentation
deliverables.description: Update current presentation architecture, setup/launcher guidance and packaged cache guide for selected profiles, common envelope, schema boundaries, mandatory-core budget exception and fixed startup recovery; preserve historical issue reports.
